budget.review_requires: GREEN exact head and DOT free review-slot confirmation

rules: Only explicit frozen UTF-8 JSON input; stdout deterministic canonical JSON; no producer execution, network, runtime discovery or fallback.
Every stage binds stage/run/source/artifact hash/UTC event time/status/reason/hashed inline evidence.

PASS requires matching explicit stage attestation and all preceding PASS stages. Receipt kind is stage-specific. Transfer receiver+destination and matching request, observation consumer identity, effect matching observation are mandatory.
Missing stage/receipt is UNKNOWN. FAIL is retained. Last-good is separately recorded and never fills current-run gaps.
Ledger PASS means manifest structure/binding validation only; actual_run_green is always UNKNOWN. Fixture stage outcomes never imply runtime effectiveness.
Observation, release, availability and fetch clocks remain distinct and nullable. No freshness threshold invented. Malformed/future recorded actual timestamps or nonmonotone stages refuse manifest.
No file existence/mtime/rclone exit0/absence of tokens is proof. Weak evidence bases are refused.
Known failures survive unchanged and do not make a structurally valid ledger REFUSED.
checks: normal pre-commit and commit-msg hooks; no bypass
frozen clean source commit; review NOT_RUN until DOT slot
stop: Denied actor/admission exact error STOP; no bypass. Exhausted cap checkpoint BLOCKED. Old lane/budgets immutable.
